long_description:
Start your morning with movement. Join Modern Day Black Hippie for beginner friendly Mat Pilates, a low-impact full-body Pilates class designed to help wake up the body and move with intention.

This beginner-friendly class focuses on mindful movement, core engagement, posture, and light strength while enjoying fresh air and the natural beauty of the park.

☀️University of SAQ🕗 10:00 AM – 10:45 AM Class will begin promptly at 10:00 AM.

Please bring a yoga mat, water, and a sweat and/or mat towel.

Limited yoga mats will be available for rent for $5 if needed.

Take this time to reconnect with your body, breathe deeply, and start the day feeling grounded and energized in community. 

Also check out other Workshops in Phoenix, Health & Wellness events in Phoenix.
